psychological_meaning: Japanese Laurel evokes feelings of nature, growth, and tranquility. It is associated with balance, harmony, and renewal, fostering a sense of peace and stability. This color often represents wealth, prosperity, and new beginnings, while also symbolizing environmental awareness and sustainability.
